title: The Mask Seller
text: A stall of masks in the Faceless City, row on row, and each one is a face from your own past: a sister, a first love, a dead friend, yourselves as children. The seller behind the stall has no face. It would like one, it says, very much.

options.label: Buy back a face you lost.

outcomes.text: It fits perfectly. They had forgotten what it felt like to be that person.

options.label: The Leader trades their own face for the finest mask.

outcomes.text: The mask is magnificent. In the mirror, the Leader is not sure who looks back.

options.label: Burn the stall and every face on it.

outcomes.text: The masks scream as they burn, every face in them, and some of the voices you know.
